description: Known-issue backlog. Items here do not fail QA. Only add with explicit user approval.

issues.message: Passwords are compared in plaintext against the database (no hashing).
issues.fix: Store bcrypt/argon2 hashes at registration and compare with bcrypt.compare() at login.

issues.message: Password is written to the database without a hashing function.
issues.fix: Hash with bcrypt (cost >= 10) before insert/update.

issues.message: Mutating API handler has no server-side session/auth verification; anyone can call it.
issues.fix: Verify a signed session (httpOnly cookie / Supabase auth) and derive the user id from it.

issues.message: API trusts a user id supplied by the client (IDOR / impersonation risk).
issues.fix: Ignore client-supplied identity; use the authenticated session's user id.
